# AI Workshop repository guidance

Read the repository root `AGENTS.md` before working here. Follow its links to `manager-instructions.md` and only the guides relevant to the request. This file is a GitHub Copilot entry point; the Workshop rules live in those shared files.

Use local agents only when this Copilot surface actually has access to the Workshop and its runner. Verify their outputs and report unavailable local access honestly. Preserve private `projects/`, `memory/`, and `usage-log.jsonl` data; they are not part of the public installer payload.
